title: Dashboard
text:
Dashboard · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact FreeGames Web Dashboard Dashboard cog setup with a separate venv so the RedBot venv stays clean. 1. Create dashboard venv Copy python3.11 -m venv ~/redbotdashboard
source ~/redbotdashboard/bin/activate
pip install -U pip wheel setuptools
pip install git+https://github.com/AAA3A-AAA3A/Red-Web-Dashboard.git
pip install flask-wtf==1.2.1 2. Enable RPC in RedBot systemd The instance name comes from redbot-setup . If your service is red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME , keep using that name. Copy ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/redenv/bin/python -O -m redbot %i --owner YOUR_DISCORD_USER_ID --team-members-are-owners --no-prompt --rpc Copy sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME 3. Configure Dashboard cog Run in DM with the bot after adding the redirect URI in Discord Developer Portal. Copy oa setdashboard redirecturi https://YOUR_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN/callback
oa setdashboard secret YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET 4. Caddy reverse proxy Copy YOUR_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN {
    reverse_proxy localhost:42356
} Copy sudo systemctl restart caddy 5. Dashboard systemd service Copy [Unit]
Description=Red-Web-Dashboard
After=network-online.target red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
User=ubuntu
Group=ubuntu
ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/redbotdashboard/bin/reddash --host localhost --port 42356
Restart=on-abnormal
RestartSec=15

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target Copy sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable reddash
sudo systemctl start reddash
sudo systemctl status reddash Close Built for potatosips · redbot-guide.potatosips.oporajita.win Prefix used in examples: oa

title: FreeGames
text:
FreeGames · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact FreeGames Free game announcement cog setup with GamerPowerAPI, plus the known fgset showsettings crash fix. What this page covers: configuring GamerPowerAPI, setting the announcement channel, selecting stores, enabling posts, and fixing the TypeError: 'set' object is not subscriptable crash in showsettings . Install Use the repo that provides freegames . Replace CRAY_BOUNTY_REPO_URL with the actual cray-bounty-cogs repository URL you use. oa repo add cray-bounty-cogs CRAY_BOUNTY_REPO_URL
oa cog install cray-bounty-cogs freegames
oa load freegames GamerPowerAPI setup Replace #free-games with your own free games announcement text channel. oa fgset gpapi channel #free-games
oa fgset gpapi stores steam epic-games-store ubisoft gog itchio ps4 ps5 xbox-one xbox-series-xs switch android ios vr battlenet origin drm-free xbox-360
oa fgset gpapi toggle
oa fgset showsettings Expected settings GamerPowerAPI: On Channel: your chosen free games text channel FreeStuffAPI: Off unless you enable it Stores: selected PC, console, mobile, VR, and DRM-free sources Known showsettings crash The setup can work correctly while oa fgset showsettings still crashes. The bug happens when the cog sends a Python set directly into cf.humanize_list() . Error in command 'freegamesset showsettings'
TypeError: 'set' object is not subscriptable Root cause conf.gamerpower.stores_to_check is stored as a set. Babel list formatting expects an indexable list-like object, so it fails when it tries to access items by index. Patch Edit the installed cog file that contains the settings display command, usually inside the RedBot venv cog install path: nano /path/to/freegames/commands/settings.py Change this: cf.humanize_list(conf.gamerpower.stores_to_check) To this: cf.humanize_list(sorted(conf.gamerpower.stores_to_check)) Suggested fixed display line: f"  - Stores to check: {cf.humanize_list(sorted(conf.gamerpower.stores_to_check)) or 'All of them'}

", Reload and verify oa reload freegames
oa fgset showsettings Notes This is not an EmbedUtils issue. This is not caused by missing Discord Embed Links permission. GamerPowerAPI configuration can still be valid; the crash is limited to the settings display command. Unrelated logs from Birthday or YALC do not affect this issue. Close Built for potatosips · redbot-guide.potatosips.oporajita.win Prefix used in examples: oa

title: Welcome
text:
Welcome · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact FreeGames Welcome Trusty Welcome setup for a public embedded welcome message with a dark Remnant 2 style. Use this for a welcome-only channel. The message points new members to general chat, memes, and voice. Do not enable auto-delete if you want welcome messages to stay. Install Copy oa cog install trusty-cogs welcome
oa load welcome Channel placeholders Replace these placeholders with your own Discord channel mentions or copied channel IDs. Purpose Example placeholder Welcome only WELCOME_CHANNEL_MENTION Chilling/general GENERAL_CHANNEL_MENTION Post memes MEMES_CHANNEL_MENTION Voice channel VOICE_CHANNEL_MENTION Target final status Setting Value Grouped greetings True Greetings enabled True Greeting channel Welcome channel Goodbyes enabled False Previous greeting deleted False Greeting deleted after None Minimum days old to greet 0 Wait for verification True Whisper / DM welcome False Embeds True Embed mention On Embed author On Embed timestamp On Important: toggle commands flip the current state. Do not repeat toggle commands after they are already on, or you may turn them off. Final safe commands Copy oa welcomeset greeting channel WELCOME_CHANNEL_MENTION
oa welcomeset whisper off
oa welcomeset greeting allowedmentions True users
oa welcomeset greeting allowedmentions False roles everyone Embed setup Copy oa welcomeset embed title WELCOME, TRAVELER
oa welcomeset embed colour #7b2cff
oa welcomeset embed footer BÁÑÍSHÊD PÃRLOR • The World remembers.
oa welcomeset embed thumbnail avatar
oa welcomeset embed image greeting https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExa3RqODkwOGY0cjFrc2ZjbTF6bHY5OTI3dHZwdjFwcG9hdm9pZmxweCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/DvC5ptlsBiNyoN5vqV/giphy.gif Only run these when the feature is currently off: Copy oa welcomeset embed mention
oa welcomeset embed author
oa welcomeset embed timestamp Clear old greeting formats Before adding the final message, open the greeting list and delete old saved formats from the interactive menu. Copy oa welcomeset greeting list Final Remnant-style welcome message Replace the channel placeholders before sending. Copy oa welcomeset greeting add 🩸 **{0.mention}... another Traveler has crossed into {1.name}.**

The crystal hums. The realm has noticed you.

Before you wander deeper:

▸ For chilling, go to GENERAL_CHANNEL_MENTION
▸ For cursed relics and memes, post in MEMES_CHANNEL_MENTION
▸ For voice, join VOICE_CHANNEL_MENTION

Stay close to the signal, Traveler.
Some worlds welcome you. This one tests you.

**{count} survivor(s) answered the call today.** Allowed mentions Command Why it matters oa welcomeset greeting allowedmentions True users Allows {0.mention} to actually ping the new member. oa welcomeset greeting allowedmentions False roles everyone Blocks role pings, @everyone , and @here from the welcome system. Commands to avoid Because the welcome messages should not be deleted automatically, do not run these: Copy oa welcomeset greeting deleteprevious
oa welcomeset greeting deleteafter Test and verify Copy oa welcomeset greeting test
oa welcomeset settings Expected final state: greetings enabled, welcome channel set, previous greeting deleted false, delete after none, wait for verification true, whisper false, embeds true. Optional bot welcome Your bot welcome can stay default. If the bot subcommand supports msg or message , you can theme it too: Copy oa help welcomeset bot
oa welcomeset bot msg 🤖 **{0.name} has entered {1.name}.**

A machine soul has crossed the threshold.
Assign it purpose before the Root does. Close Built for potatosips · redbot-guide.potatosips.oporajita.win Prefix used in examples: oa

title: YALC
text:
YALC · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact FreeGames YALC Yet Another Logging Cog. Current recommended setup: keep YALC loaded, but enable only voice state logging. Final clean state: Enabled events: 1 , voice_state_update points to your voice log text channel, and validation shows 0 issues. Install Copy oa repo add taakoscogs https://github.com/TaakoOfficial/TaakosCogs
oa cog install taakoscogs YALC
oa load YALC Initial setup This creates the YALC Logs category and all default log channels. Use it once for a full setup. Copy oa yalc setup CONFIRM Keep only voice join/leave logs If full setup enabled too many logs, disable everything first, then enable only voice state logging. Copy oa yalc bulk_disable all
oa yalc enable voice_state_update
oa yalc setchannel voice_state_update VOICE_LOG_TEXT_CHANNEL_ID
oa yalc validate
oa yalc settings Use the text channel ID where you want voice join, leave, move, mute, deafen, stream, camera, and related voice state logs to appear. Do not bulk-enable voice unless needed voice_state_update is enough for normal voice join/leave logging. Only use bulk voice logging if you want every voice-related YALC event. Copy # Optional only if you want every voice category event
oa yalc bulk_enable voice Validation notes 0 issues If oa yalc validate says found 0 issues, the setup is good. Warnings are okay Warnings like disabled events still having assigned channels are not a problem. Disabled events will not log anything unless enabled again. Diagnostics Copy oa yalc test
oa yalc dashboard Avoid reset Do not run oa yalc reset unless you want to wipe YALC channel mappings and settings. Close Built for potatosips · redbot-guide.potatosips.oporajita.win Prefix used in examples: oa

title: Installation
text:
Installation · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact FreeGames Installation Ubuntu 24.04 LTS setup for Red-DiscordBot using Python 3.11, a virtual environment, and systemd. Always keep the official Red documentation open and follow it first: docs.discord.red/en/stable . This page is the practical potatosips setup version. 1. Install Ubuntu packages Recommended base system: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS . Copy sudo apt update
sudo apt -y install software-properties-common
sudo add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa -y
sudo apt update
sudo apt -y install python3.11 python3.11-dev python3.11-venv git openjdk-17-jre-headless build-essential nano 2. Create RedBot virtual environment Copy python3.11 -m venv ~/redenv
source ~/redenv/bin/activate
pip install -U pip wheel setuptools
pip install Red-DiscordBot 3. Create the bot instance Run setup and choose your instance name. In my setup the instance name was also redbot , but yours can be different. Copy redbot-setup 4. Start manually once In redbot redbot , the first redbot is the terminal command. The second redbot is the instance name made by redbot-setup . Replace the second one if your instance name is different. Copy redbot YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME --owner YOUR_DISCORD_USER_ID --team-members-are-owners 5. systemd service Create a template service so red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME starts the matching RedBot instance. Copy sudo nano /etc/systemd/system/red@.service Copy [Unit]
Description=%i redbot
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
User=ubuntu
Group=ubuntu
WorkingDirectory=/home/ubuntu
ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/redenv/bin/python -O -m redbot %i --owner YOUR_DISCORD_USER_ID --team-members-are-owners --no-prompt --rpc
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=20

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target 6. Enable and start Replace YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME with the instance name you created in redbot-setup . Copy sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME
sudo systemctl start red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME
sudo systemctl status red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME 7. Check logs Copy sudo journalctl -u red@YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME -n 80 --no-pager Close Built for potatosips · redbot-guide.potatosips.oporajita.win Prefix used in examples: oa

title: Troubleshooting
text:
Troubleshooting · potatosips ps potatosips RedBot Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Search Menu Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Guide Home Install Core Setup Customization Troubleshooting Cogs Welcome RoleTools Tickets AutoRoom Retrigger Snipe ExtendedModLog YALC Voice Logs Dashboard Birthday AutoReact FreeGames Troubleshooting Common errors hit during the setup and the fix. Ticket button creates nothing Check bot logs. In this setup, wrong welcome placeholders caused errors. Use {owner_mention} , not {ticket_owner.mention} . Copy oa settickets welcomemessage main Hey {owner_mention}! You've opened a ticket. SUPPORT_STAFF_MENTION will be with you shortly. Ticket logs posting in panel channel Move logs to your chosen log text channel. Copy oa settickets logschannel main LOG_TEXT_CHANNEL_ID Button says “secondary Open a Ticket” The style must be a number. Copy oa settickets clearmessage BOT_PANEL_MESSAGE_ID
oa settickets addbutton BOT_PANEL_MESSAGE_ID main 🎫 2 Open a Ticket Welcome says 2th The cog does not auto-format ordinals. Use “soul number {count}”. YALC voice logs not showing Run full setup, then set the voice event to your chosen voice log text channel. Copy oa yalc setup CONFIRM
oa yalc setchannel voice_state_update VOICE_LOG_TEXT_CHANNEL_ID RedBot command confusion In redbot YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME , redbot is the terminal command and YOUR_INSTANCE_NAME is the instance made in redbot-setup .
